title: How was getting started with {product}? A 4-minute check-in
description: Tell us how your first weeks with {product} went, so the {team} can make getting started faster for everyone after you.
audience: People who signed up for {product} in the last 30 days
purpose: Decide which onboarding step to fix first by finding where new users get stuck and what helps them reach value

welcome.title: How was getting started?
welcome.description:
We're the {team} at {company}. You joined {product} recently, so you know better than anyone where getting started is smooth and where it's not. Your answers decide what we fix first.
• Takes about 4 minutes
• Anonymous: only the {team} sees answers, in summary
• Voluntary: you can stop at any time
• Open until {date}. Questions? {contact}

thank_you.title: Thank you, that's everything
thank_you.description: We'll use your answers to improve the first-week experience, and share what changed within a month of {date}. Questions? {contact}
